title: vercel/eve: an open framework for building and deploying agents
friendlyTitle: Eve is an open toolkit for building AI agents
summary: Eve is Vercel’s open TypeScript framework for building agents with tools, workflows, sandboxes and web-chat deployment. The beta project has more than 5,000 stars and remains under active development.
friendlySummary: Vercel’s Eve project helps TypeScript developers create agents with tools, workflows and web chat.
whyItMatters: Teams building JavaScript or TypeScript agents can use Eve as a structured starting point for tool execution, stateful workflows and deployment rather than wiring each part together independently. Its beta status means APIs and behaviour may still change.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can save setup work when building an agent application. Expect changes because the project is still in beta.
